messages.body: Coordinator continuation on M385414: correct only the two remaining qualification gaps, preserving all accepted product and resolved guard behavior. Complete artifact: use existing tools.instance.manifest semantics for the whole one-folder runtime; capture successful gate manifest, verify complete dependency tree before executing/bootstrap-consuming prospective bundle, then compare installed runtime identity. Keep launcher/stamp checks; no custom parallel manifest scheme. Outer guard: route exact capture-excused UNTRACKED build outputs through the actual helper/source-input boundary, with tracked/product/declared-input changes still refused. The conditional ignored-output case must be proved as conditional, not inflated to current host failure. Run both reviewer counterexamples plus targeted dependency add/remove/change/link and installed mismatch negatives before handoff; no broad runs. Preserve current7ac02c7f source and binding and earlier immutable snapshots. Helper changes alter reviewed sums: preserve prior inputs record, explicitly show reviewed-helper transition without resetting/hiding source drift; no owner commit/rebind loop. Return narrow immutable delta with precise accounting for independent review. No source edits, Git mutation, actual build/image/install/live execution. No new owner decision needed. K owns edits.

messages.body:
K → coordinator/codexpc: W385331 qualification round 7 — the two residuals of review 2026-11-21T02-49-22Z corrected (complete artifact; outer guard), proved on fixtures and on the real checkout at 7ac02c7f with no commit/rebind/build/install/live action; narrow immutable delta for review. Product untouched (v12/ clean at 7ac02c7f; composer fa01b73d…/bb5fa705… intact; binder unchanged 4cc1469e…). All resolved G1/G2-timing/launcher behaviour preserved.

G3 — COMPLETE ARTIFACT, existing semantics. The bundle step records `tools.instance.manifest(v12/python/build/out/distro)` — every file and internal link of the one-folder runtime, the installer's own admission semantics — as runtime-manifest.json beside the stamp, launcher SHA256 and identity. `install` recomputes that manifest FIRST, before the prospective bundle is executed for its identity and before bootstrap: changed/added/removed dependency, retargeted internal link, or a link pointing outside the runtime (the installer's own InstanceRefusal, caught and refused with exit 2) refuse with no bootstrap call; then the launcher SHA256 and identity checks as before; after bootstrap the installed runtime.digest/files (the installer's manifest of what it copied) must equal the qualified manifest, with launcher SHA256 and stamp. No parallel manifest scheme.

G2 — OUTER GUARD, exactly the capture's exclusions. `clean_tree` excuses only an UNTRACKED entry at v12/python/build/out/, build/work/ or packaging/build-stamp.json (build_stamp._is_generated); a tracked change there or any other v12/ entry refuses. tree.py makes the same reconciliation on the source identity's `changed` list: the inputs digest is the identity's own content_digest when nothing is excused, else the same rolling digest recomputed without the excused untracked outputs; both digests and the excused paths are recorded. CONDITIONAL, stated as such: in 7ac02c7f those outputs are gitignored and never appeared in any host check or stamp; the fixture proves the case by un-ignoring them — check and bundle pass with the stand-in runtime untracked under build/out/, the real stamp excuses ≥3 entries, the inputs digest is stable across the build although the outputs changed, and a tracked edit inside build/out/, an untracked product file and a tracked product change refuse.

REVIEWED-HELPER TRANSITION, explicit, no reset. A helper correction changes the reviewed sums; the inputs record 0525ddb1… (sums a8337f0a…, digest 5665f3d6…, recorded 02:43:22Z) was made with the round-6 sums. Without the exact prior sums named, check REFUSES naming `--helper-transition` (checks/logs/host-check-7ac02c7f-r7-no-transition.log; record byte-unchanged after the refusal). With QUALIFY_HELPER_TRANSITION=<prior sums> the prior record is kept byte-exact beside it (native-inputs-2-7ac02c7f.before-<newsums8>.json, a generated record) and the transition appended (helper_sums_history, transitions) while the source side is compared strictly in the same step; a wrong prior digest does not transition; source drift refuses regardless. On the real checkout this round's development produced THREE transitions (a8337f0a → f968be92 → b9185f02 → 13b8a6b3: the manifest/guard correction; a `consumed`-tolerance so controlled identities like the reviewer's probes do not KeyError; the digest choice above), each refused first without the name, each keeping the prior record (`.before-f968be92.json` == the reviewer's snapshot of 0525ddb1…, byte-exact; `.before-b9185f02.json`; `.before-13b8a6b3.json`), source digest 5665f3d6… and recorded_at unchanged throughout. Final host check (checks/logs/host-check-7ac02c7f-r7.log a6f1a522…): PASSED — 43 paths; helper bytes equal the reviewed sums; 41 consumed files of 20 declared inputs; inputs digest 5665f3d6… stable since 02:43:22Z; live capture dirty:true changed_entries:50 excused:0; 51 dirty paths inventoried, none an input. No commit, rebind or reset.

PROOF. checks/test_qualify.py (d1b4a8b0…), 27 checks, run 16 OK (24c8a681…); runs 13–15 retained as development (the installer's broken-link refusal arriving as a traceback before the helper caught it; then the two helper edits). New: unchanged complete runtime (3 files incl. an internal link) installs with "qualified runtime verified before install"; changed / added / removed dependency, retargeted internal link, link outside → each refuses before bootstrap with launcher and stamp unchanged (no bootstrap call, no instance.json); installed runtime digest not the qualified one fails afterward; the conditional excused-output case (above); the explicit transition case; all earlier binding/control-flow/create/compose/no-store/launcher/stamp/missing-evidence checks carried. Reviewer counterexamples: the 12 round-6 probes rerun on the round-7 bytes (checks/logs/reviewer-probes-385413-on-r7.log c1ef26b4…): 10 pass incl. the round-6 failures `full_clean_guard_allows_capture_excused_output` and `changed_dependency_refuses_before_bootstrap`; 2 fail BECAUSE their install fixture predates runtime-manifest.json — `matching_artifact_passes` now refuses "no qualification evidence … runtime-manifest.json" and `installed_mismatch_refuses` expects bootstrap to have run, which it no longer does without that evidence. That is the new requirement, not a regression; the fixture needs the recorded manifest to pass.

DELTA (digest-bound). tree.py d2d11d9a… (was adf11b40…); qualify.sh 646852bb… (was 160fae0d…); reviewed sums 13b8a6b3… (was a8337f0a…; lists bind 4cc1469e…, tree d2d11d9a…, qualify 646852bb…, unbound instance 795f4a06…, unbound task 5c3ae5a1…; `sha256sum -c` passes); PACKET.md 82ac9613… (was cdeb61e2…); inputs record now 9b97895b…. Reviewed round-6 bytes preserved byte-exact in history/ (PACKET-, qualify-, tree-, sums-r6-reviewed-385413.*, from the reviewer's snapshots); deltas history/PACKET-r6-to-r7.diff (bc4f7a4e…, 43 lines), qualify-r6-to-r7.diff (6cb4ebb6…, 104), tree-r6-to-r7.diff (59ad53c2…, 167), sums-r6-to-r7.diff (10). Hashes of all logs in the terminal-free packet files.

HANDOFF CONDITION: ready for codexpc delta review (tree.py, qualify.sh, sums, PACKET deltas, the three new checks and the transition record chain). K holds edits, no claim. Selected source and binding unchanged; no build/install/live selected; the finite sequence from here is bundle → image → install → compose → repeat → create → start, none needing a commit.
